Use case: precise-object-edit.
Revise the supplied illustrated physical board into a readable tabletop board design while retaining the approved three-biome illustration, overhead landscape format, cardboard edge, rich colours, pond / lush meadow / barren wasteland, and TWO bridge connections. Render at high resolution, preferably 3840 by 2560, with clean legible printed typography. It should be a beautiful illustrated BOARD, not an app dashboard.

CRITICAL USER NEED: it must be unmistakable exactly WHERE an encounter tile is placed, what that position scores, and which individual positions are resting spots. Preserve the artwork but REDRAW the entire track with precisely FIFTY-THREE numbered placement/scoring pads, 01 through 53 exactly once, plus a separate small starting dock marked "0 • DUCK START". The numbered pads all share one visual grammar: broad warm cream irregular square stone, strong continuous dark outline, a large empty flat central well that can physically receive a token; a little position number at its top; a crisp narrow cream reward tab ATTACHED BELOW the pad with P and T values. The reward tab must remain visible when a token covers the central well. No unlabelled stones or plain path areas may resemble extra tile pads. Use narrow earth trails between pads to distinguish connectors from placement spaces. Avoid alternating blank stones and path patches.

PRECISE ROUTE LAYOUT:
Three adjacent open U-shaped excursions, one per biome, joined at the TOP by bridges. Start dock above first pad at upper left.
Pond, 18 pads: left column TOP to BOTTOM = 01 02 03 04 05 06 07 08; bottom bend LEFT to RIGHT = 09 10; right column BOTTOM to TOP = 11 12 13 14 15 16 17 18. Bridge from18 to19.
Meadow, 18 pads: left column TOP to BOTTOM =19 20 21 22 23 24 25 26; bottom bend LEFT to RIGHT =27 28; right column BOTTOM to TOP =29 30 31 32 33 34 35 36. Bridge from36 to37.
Wasteland, 17 pads: left column TOP to BOTTOM =37 38 39 40 41 42 43 44; bottom bend =45; right column BOTTOM to TOP =46 47 48 49 50 51 52 53.
Keep enough central scenery between each pair of pad columns so all three landscapes are substantial. Exactly two ends, no closed rings, branching trails or shortcuts. Number53 is the terminal scoring pad; label its tab "FINAL" very small. Do not add a 54th numbered pad.

REWARDS: each pad's attached reward tab reads the exact P and T pair below. P = Pond pennies, T = Twigs. NEVER confuse the position number with the printed P value. Some P values repeat; that is intentional. Preserve ALL these pairs, including zeroes:
01 = P1 T0; 02 = P2 T0; 03 = P3 T0; 04 = P4 T0; 05 = P5 T0 REST; 06 = P6 T1; 07 = P7 T1; 08 = P8 T1; 09 = P9 T1; 10 = P10 T2; 11 = P11 T2; 12 = P12 T2; 13 = P13 T2 REST; 14 = P14 T3; 15 = P15 T3; 16 = P15 T3; 17 = P16 T3; 18 = P16 T4; 19 = P17 T4; 20 = P17 T4 REST; 21 = P18 T4; 22 = P18 T5; 23 = P19 T5; 24 = P19 T5; 25 = P20 T5; 26 = P20 T6; 27 = P21 T6; 28 = P21 T6 REST; 29 = P22 T7; 30 = P22 T7; 31 = P23 T7; 32 = P23 T8; 33 = P24 T8; 34 = P24 T8 REST; 35 = P25 T9; 36 = P25 T9; 37 = P26 T9; 38 = P26 T10; 39 = P27 T10; 40 = P27 T10 REST; 41 = P28 T11; 42 = P28 T11; 43 = P29 T11; 44 = P29 T12; 45 = P30 T12; 46 = P30 T12 REST; 47 = P31 T12; 48 = P31 T13; 49 = P32 T13; 50 = P32 T13; 51 = P33 T14; 52 = P33 T14 REST; 53 = P35 T15

EIGHT RESTING PADS ONLY: 05,13,20,28,34,40,46,52. The pad itself is the resting clearing; do not put a scenic shelter nearby ambiguously or label a whole biome as a rest. The numeral and P/T tab stay fully visible. Use a small bush canopy or reed shelter for05 and13, lush flower/leaf/log shelters for20,28,34, and exceptionally sheltered little rock hollows amid bare wasteland for40,46,52. There are exactly eight feather/rest markers. Any other decorative scenery does not get a similar frame or marker. Resting markers DO NOT change the P/T values.

Integrate a slim printed key into the board's lower border, with these exact short labels and tiny matching examples: "TILE HERE" beside an empty pad; "P = Pond pennies"; "T = Twigs"; feather icon with "REST"; and "Score the next empty space". Make typography functional and understated, like printed physical tabletop component rules, not UI controls. Keep all pads empty to show their placement wells. No generated duck characters, tokens, score panels, buttons, menus, logo or marketing title.

Priority: exact 01–53 sequence and supplied P/T values, eight clearly assigned resting pads, unambiguous tile wells, preserved three-biome artwork. This is an image review only; do not depict software.
